heading: EXT. ENCHANTED ORCHARD, STONE WELL - DAWN

units.text: EXT. ENCHANTED ORCHARD, STONE WELL - DAWN
Apple trees hang heavy with silver fruit.
Mist curls over the grass.
A moss-green well stands at the center, its rim carved with runes that faintly glow.
ALARIC THORNE, thirties, a wandering knight in a travel-stained cloak, kneels at the well's edge, lowering a leather bucket on a rope.
His horse grazes nearby.
The bucket rises.
He tips it and drinks from his hands.
The water glitters.
A branch snaps behind him.
He spins, hand on his hilt.
PERCIVAL ASHDOWN, thirties, in a scholar's gray robe, steps out of the trees with a satchel over one shoulder and a book in his hand.
He raises his empty palm.
Peace, friend. I mean no harm.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: Most who say that do.
units.name: ALARIC

units.text: Then I shall say it quietly.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: Alaric lowers his hand.
Percival smiles, steps to the well, and peers over the rim.
You've drunk from it.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: I was thirsty.
units.name: ALARIC

units.text: Of course. Everyone is.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: He closes his book and tucks it into the satchel.
What does it do?
units.name: ALARIC

units.text: It shows you what you've lost.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: I've lost nothing.
units.name: ALARIC

units.text: Then you won't mind looking.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: He nods at the well.
Alaric hesitates, then bends over the rim.
The water stills.
Something pale rises in it.
He watches it for a long moment, and his shoulders go slack.
He turns away from the well and wipes his face with his sleeve.
He does not look at the scholar, who has the decency to look at the trees.
How far is the nearest village?
units.name: ALARIC

units.text: Half a day. I will walk with you, if you like.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: I prefer to walk alone.
units.name: ALARIC

units.text: Then I shall walk very far behind.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: Alaric almost smiles.
He gathers his horse's reins and starts across the orchard.
Percival waits until the knight is a dozen paces ahead, then follows, whistling softly.
